Hey there! 🌿 Great question—your puppy's safety is what matters most!

**Go with the parlour palm!** It's pet-safe, so no worries if your curious pup decides to nibble on it.

The snake plant, on the other hand, is **not pet-safe**, so it's best to skip that one with a puppy in the house.

The parlour palm is a beautiful, low-maintenance plant that'll be a safe addition to your home. Plus, it's forgiving with watering, which is perfect if you've got your hands full with a new pup! 🐕

If you'd like any care tips once your palm arrives, or if you have other plant questions down the line, feel free to reach out. We're here to help you build a thriving (and puppy-friendly!) plant collection!
